knownLimitationsLog.limitation: KI-1: No admin.py registered for client_portal models. Django admin site does not surface these models.
knownLimitationsLog.impact: Staff users cannot manage client_portal records via /admin/ until admin registration is added.
knownLimitationsLog.workaround: Use the seed script or Django shell to manage records until Phase 2 adds admin registration.

knownLimitationsLog.limitation: KI-2: No views.py or urls.py exist for client_portal. No HTTP interface is present in Phase 1.
knownLimitationsLog.impact: E2E tests are not applicable for this phase. End-to-end verification is deferred to Phase 2 when URL routing is added.
knownLimitationsLog.workaround: Verify data via Django shell or admin once KI-1 is resolved.

knownLimitationsLog.limitation: KI-3: DeliverableVersion and MessageThread are included as supporting ORM models (12 total) required for ForeignKey referential integrity by Approval and Message.
knownLimitationsLog.impact: No functional impact; models are correct. Documentation should clarify these are bridge models, not primary aggregates.

knownLimitationsLog.limitation: N+1 query risk in __str__ methods: Milestone, DeliverableVersion, Approval, MessageThread, Message, and InvoiceRecord each traverse at least one ForeignKey relation in their __str__ methods.
knownLimitationsLog.impact: If any of these models are displayed in a list view without select_related(), each list item will execute additional database queries. No views exist in Phase 1, so there is no current runtime impact.
knownLimitationsLog.workaround: All list querysets in Phase 2 views and admin registrations must use select_related() for the affected FK chains: Milestone->Project, DeliverableVersion->Deliverable, Approval->DeliverableVersion->Deliverable, MessageThread->Project, Message->Thread and Sender, InvoiceRecord->Organization.

knownLimitationsLog.limitation: Missing db_index on Project.status and InvoiceRecord.status fields. ProjectRepository.list_by_status() and equivalent invoice status filters will perform full table scans on large datasets.
knownLimitationsLog.impact: Performance degradation on list_by_status queries at scale. Not observable in Phase 1 with no views or queries.
knownLimitationsLog.workaround: Add db_index=True to Project.status and InvoiceRecord.status in a Phase 2 migration when repository implementations are written.

openFindings.description: FileRecord.storage_path is a plain CharField with no model-level path traversal validation. Validation must be enforced at the application service boundary before any storage path is written. No attack surface exists in Phase 1 since there is no HTTP interface.

N+1 risk: DeliverableVersion.__str__ queries Deliverable (1 extra query per row)
N+1 risk: Approval.__str__ traverses DeliverableVersion then Deliverable (2 extra queries per row)
N+1 risk: MessageThread.__str__ queries Project (1 extra query per row)
N+1 risk: Message.__str__ queries UserProfile and MessageThread (2 extra queries per row)
N+1 risk: InvoiceRecord.__str__ queries ClientOrganization (1 extra query per row)
